summary: Data from MyLovely.AI, a platform for creating NSFW AI companions and images, was leaked and posted on a cybercrime forum and added to Have I Been Pwned in April 2026. It includes email addresses, user IDs, user-created prompts, links to generated images, a limited number of Discord and X usernames, subscription information, storage URLs and content-moderation reports, and two datasets of about 113,000 explicit prompts, nearly 70,000 of which can be linked to specific user IDs. More than 100,000 users were affected. How the data was obtained has not been disclosed.
